title: Drink, Ride, Sing and Dance Bar Tour
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
21+ event. Valid ID must be presented for entry to each club. Passports required for international guests.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
From beginning to end count on a great time! We're not talking about your local dive bar. Think club worthy DJs & lighting, in spaces where t-shirt & jeans are the vibe. Have the BEST night out with friends, old & new!

- You'll start things off with a FREE welcome kit (including drink ticket, LED ring, optional complimentary bull ride), along with some karaoke action at our meeting location, DOUBLE DEUCE!

- Next, prime up those dancing shoes while we soak in the lights and sounds at the brand-spankin' new,70's themed bar, GOOD NIGHT JOHN BOY. 

- Next up, we'll continue the excitement by heading to the third bar, AMERICAN JUNKIE, where dancing on the bar top is encouraged while the DJ does his thing. Exclusive beer & White Claw drink specials here just for us.

- We'll then end the night at a local bar/club favorite, WHISKEY GIRL, with spacious dance floors and always rockin' DJs!! Here you can take advantage of drink deals.

So. Much. Fun!!!
